summary: Organon & Co. filed an 8-K announcing entry into a definitive merger agreement with Sun Pharmaceutical Holdings (and affiliates) on April 26, 2026. Under the agreement, Merger Sub will merge into Organon, and each share of Organon common stock will be converted into the right to receive $14.00 in cash, representing a 103% premium over Organon's closing price on April 9, 2026. The board has recommended the transaction. Parent has secured committed debt financing to fund the consideration and repay Organon's existing debt. Outstanding equity awards will be canceled for cash. The deal is structured as a cash tender offer/merger, subject to regulatory approvals and closing conditions. Watch for shareholder vote and antitrust review timelines.
